page.notes: The first word "tiquissimos" is a fragment: the printed line begins with "tiqvissimos", the start of "antiquissimos" lies on the previous page. The catchword "esse" at the foot is the first word of the next page. The image also shows "inqvit" with q, normalised to "inquit" in the text. The text is printed with long s, which is transcribed as plain s. The mark "(s)" is the reference in the text and in the footnote. No marginal notes. Show-through and the scan edge at the right are not transcribed.
